sentences.en: A unique fossil of a tropical plant was found recently.
sentences.zh: 最近发现了一种热带植物的独特化石。

sentences.en: It is easy to consider man unique among living organisms.
sentences.zh: 很容易认为人类在所有生物中是独一无二的。

sentences.en: He made a speech using his unique tone of voice.
sentences.zh: 他用自己独特的声音发表了演讲。

senses.zh: 独一无二的，独特的；非常特别的，极不寻常的；（某人、地或事物）独具的，特有的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：uni（单一）+que（…的）→唯一的
